scenario_steps.name: a copy of `fixtures/cad/ellipse/rotated-measured.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in RIGHT view
the user enables Display Curvature on the ellipse
the ellipse has Display Curvature enabled
the user choose Setup Curvature Display from its context menu
Curvature Settings shows two Minimum-to-Maximum sliders without numeric values
OK and Apply are initially disabled
the user advance the upper slider
the thumb advances and the comb becomes denser
the dialog closes and the earlier sparse comb returns
